question_text: A local government unit (LGU) passes an ordinance requiring all women employees to submit a certificate of non-pregnancy every quarter as a condition for continued employment. Which provision of RA 9710 (Magna Carta of Women) does this violate?

options.text: The right to equal treatment before the law
The prohibition against discrimination in employment based on pregnancy
The right to reproductive health services
The right to non-discrimination in political participation
